title: Lights Out problem (toggle-plus, GF(2) unique press set) v1

width.description: board width; only the 5x4 shape has a full-column-rank toggle matrix

height.description: board height; 4x4 and 5x5 have nullity 4 and 2 and can never be unique

initial.description: row-major light vector; 1 is lit, 0 is unlit. The goal is the all-ones vector.

$comment: Action contract: kind is "toggle_cell", actor_id is "cell-<x>-<y>", params is {"cell": [x, y]} - a dict[str, list[int]], within plugin protocol v1's Action shape. Pressing a cell toggles that cell and its in-bounds orthogonal neighbours. Presses commute and are involutive, so a solution is a set of cells; the unique press set is the GF(2) solution of A s = initial XOR all-ones, proven unique by nullity 0.
